blockingIssues.description: The new regression suite does not actually exercise the cold bootstrap fix in `apps/web/app/account/page.tsx:15-20`. It only asserts route cache exports, renders `AccountShellLoading` by itself, and hydrates `ControlPlaneShell` with identical props, so reverting the page-level `<Suspense fallback={<AccountShellLoading />}>` could still leave the automated suite green.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Explicitly require browser verification for cold authenticated account-shell fixes to inspect the first bridge-cookie load before any reload and to pair that manual check with automated coverage that exercises the real routed page boundary rather than only isolated shell hydration.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The original failed follow-up handoff and the new fix review both identified that warmed reloads can mask the issue. The current skill mentions bridge-cookie bootstrap coverage but does not tell workers to inspect the first unreloaded load or to ensure route-level automation covers the actual `/account` page boundary.
